name: Macro Headwind Simulator
prompt:
"Build a 'Macroeconomic Headwind Simulator' for the executive team. The base dataset is the current fiscal year's Projected Revenue, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), and Net Profit Margin broken down by product line.

The UI must feature:

A clean, minimalist layout with three massive KPI cards: Target Net Profit, Simulated Net Profit, and Delta ($ Variance).

A sidebar containing three macro levers (sliders): 'Inflation Spike' (0% to 10%), 'Supply Chain Tariff' (0% to 25%), and 'Interest Rate Hike' (0% to 5%).

Moving any slider must instantly recalculate the Simulated Net Profit using a compound erosion formula and update a waterfall chart showing exactly where the revenue leaks are occurring across product lines."

thought_process.interpretation: I have designed this as an 'Executive Strategy Utility'. The persona is a C-Suite executive who needs to perform high-stakes sensitivity analysis on margin erosion. I prioritized a 'Simulated vs Target' mental model, where every slider movement immediately recalculates the P&L impact across a compound erosion formula. The Waterfall chart provides the tactical breakdown of where these leaks occur by product category.
assumed_from_scratch: Macro Slider Controls (Custom implementation of the Lever UI)
Waterfall Chart logic (Using Recharts stacked BarChart with transparent offsets)
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'simulation_controls.md' skill for complex sliders/knobs and a 'financial_waterfall.md' visualization skill would standardize these executive-level modeling tasks.
